name: ANSI/IEEE Current window monitoring relay form
aliases: IEEE Minimum and Maximum Current Protection
summary: IEEE-library form of current window monitoring relay: a current-window relay supervises both minimum and maximum current conditions.
description: This reference locates current window monitoring relay in Autodesk's IEEE-oriented current protection relays family. A current-window relay supervises both minimum and maximum current conditions. Its drawing links the measured circuit to separate or combined outputs according to the actual relay configuration. The public library uses HCR1F27 for its horizontal representation; this is a vendor block name, not an IEEE standards symbol number.

Trace the measured quantity or initiating control signal separately from the output contacts. The device tag links the sensing or operating element to the controlled circuit; settings, reset behaviour and the actual terminal arrangement belong in the selected equipment documentation.

Identify the permitted current band and any start-up inhibition. A current window is a range-supervision function, not a measurement accuracy band. The linked functional counterpart explains the same operating role in its own drawing context; agreement of every detailed convention mark is not asserted.
